tool_input.prompt: What is the current stable TypeScript version shown? Any beta versions mentioned?

tool_result_content:
The current stable version shown is **TypeScript 7.0**. The npm section says: "To do this, run `npm install -g typescript`. This will install the latest version (currently 7.0)."

A beta is referenced, but only indirectly. The Release Notes section lists "What's upcoming in 7.1?", which links to a blog post whose URL ends in `announcing-typescript-7-1-beta`. The page text itself doesn't use the word "beta," so the beta status comes from the link URL.
